Erdogan Raises Kashmir Issue at UNGA; India Responds

Turkish President Tayyip Erdogan raised the issue of Kashmir during his address at the UN General Assembly. While the specific details of his remarks were not provided in the coverage, his mention of Kashmir was reported by The Print. Firstpost, in its coverage, framed the issue by questioning Erdogan's stance, highlighting alleged hypocrisy regarding the Kurds and Armenians, and pointing to perceived double standards. The coverage does not include India's response.
